Change in cumulative level of exceedance vs the Reference
note: One setting changed per row; labels show the cumulative LoE of that row and its change from the Reference. Rows that do not enter a principle (e.g. the GDP measure for AR) show no change. Percentages are relative to carbon 2026–2050 (time-resolved accounting); fixed absolute terms such as soil carbon loss therefore show larger percentage effects than under whole-life accounting. The largest effects on the AR and AtP LoE, grouped: Extended Data ED4 (carbon: ED1).
